title: Find the display names of users who obtained both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter'
question: Find the display names of users who obtained both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges, have a reputation greater than 1000, and own at least one post created in 2010 that is among the top 10 most valuable (by FavoriteCount) posts of that year.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_2010_posts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_026" AS PostId
    FROM posts
    WHERE strftime('%Y', "XCL_029") = '2010'
    ORDER BY "XCL_039" DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
users_with_badges AS (
    SELECT u."XCL_052" AS UserId
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
    WHERE u."XCL_053" > 1000
      AND b."XCL_003" IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
    GROUP BY u."XCL_052"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b."XCL_003") = 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055" AS DisplayName
FROM users u
INNER JOIN users_with_badges ub ON u."XCL_052" = ub.UserId
INNER JOIN posts p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN top_2010_posts tp ON p."XCL_026" = tp.PostId

    SELECT "XCL_026" AS PostId
    FROM posts
    WHERE strftime('%Y', "XCL_029") = '2010'
    ORDER BY "XCL_039" DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
users_with_badges AS (
    SELECT u."XCL_052" AS UserId
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
    WHERE u."XCL_053" > 1000
      AND b."XCL_003" IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
    GROUP BY u."XCL_052"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b."XCL_003") = 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055" AS DisplayName
FROM users u
INNER JOIN users_with_badges ub ON u."XCL_052" = ub.UserId
INNER JOIN posts p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN top_2010_posts tp ON p."XCL_026" = tp.PostId
